text.text: Plan the week from one page. Recurring and one-off cleans land on the Cleans board, each team lead sees their own list under Mine, and Mark done closes a clean. Supplies shows what to buy and Invoices shows who has not paid. Start on the Dashboard each Monday.

This week at a glance: cleans by status, earnings by type and unpaid invoices.
A first clean sets the tone for a long relationship. Take longer, take photos and ask questions.
Confirm the time and access by text the day before.
Pack extra time, about 30 minutes over a normal clean.
Walk the home with the client if they are there and agree the priorities.
Photograph existing damage before you touch anything.
Clean top to bottom and back to front so you never re-walk a floor.
Send a short thank-you text and ask if anything was missed. Log what you learned in the client notes.
One missed room costs more than ten good cleans earn. Check at the door and fix quickly.
Every team lead does the walk-through before leaving.
Fix anything you see on the spot.
Reply the same day and apologize once.
Offer a free re-clean within 48 hours.
Log the cause on the clean and review it at Friday huddle.
Run out of one product and a team cleans slower all week. Order every other Thursday.
Count each van and the supply room.
Update On hand on the Supplies list.
Order every row marked Reorder from the supplier.
Never mix bleach and ammonia products. Keep original labels on every bottle and never refill an unmarked one.
